text: Mobile app development is an exciting field today. When building an app, developers must consider responsive design, which means the app looks and works well on different screen sizes. They also choose between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one platform, while cross-platform apps work on several. After development, apps are usually published on app stores like Google Play or the Apple App Store. Performance is another key factor, because users expect apps to run quickly and smoothly. A slow app can frustrate people and make them delete it. Therefore, developers test their apps carefully before releasing them to the public.
